caption:
Microsoft's 2026 Work Trend Index puts 32% of Indian professionals in the "Frontier" category. Globally it's 16%. India is running ahead on AI adoption.

Read what that means for your career. The analysis you stayed late to perfect is now a prompt. The deck that used to mark you out as thorough is table stakes. Output is being commoditised faster here than almost anywhere.

What does not commoditise: judgment, and the bearing to deliver it.

Who holds the room when the numbers are contested. Who speaks last and moves the decision. Who can sit in a three-second silence without filling it.

Thirty-five years of command teaches you this early. The officer with the best plan does not always win the room. The one with the steadiest voice does.

If your ideas are still being ignored until someone else repeats them, the problem was never the quality of your work. It was the delivery of it.

topic.title: India's AI-forward workforce makes judgment the promotion currency
topic.angle: Lumina's audience has competed on output and analysis — exactly what AI is commoditising fastest in India — leaving how you hold a room, and calculated silence, as the real differentiator.
topic.why_now: Microsoft's 2026 Work Trend Index India findings released 3 September (32% 'Frontier Professionals' vs 16% globally) are still being syndicated and are the stat every Indian leadership commentator is quoting right now.

rationale: A stark, text-only stat card matches the authoritative, no-nonsense tone and lets the Microsoft figure carry the weight without visual clutter.
